Renamed the title to Regular Bethe data give transfer-family eigenpairs and synchronized the manifest. Independently checked RTT components, both induction identities, Bethe-equation cancellation and polynomial pole removal, including M=0 and excluded singular roots. The full existing eigenpair Statement and proof are sound and unchanged. Fatal title overstatement is repaired without claiming completeness.

decisions.evidence: Verified the cited Faddeev PDF: section 4 equations (108)–(112), PDF p.15, give momentum, energy and epsilon(p)=cos p-1; section 5 begins on p.16 before (113)–(115), which concern logarithmic equations, large-N momenta and scattering. Corrected both item locators and manifest source metadata, explicitly recording H_source=(1/2)sum(P-I) and E=2J epsilon+JN. The local two-step finite-basis proof is sound for all N>=3, real J and modes 0<=m<N, so this is a nonfatal citation-location defect, with no changed Example or logical argument.

Replaced the sentence with the exact factor t(0)=i^N U and preserved shift orientation, logarithmic derivative, page inventory and prerequisites. Reviewed all page claims against the eight finite-chain carriers; no completeness or empirical conclusion is asserted. The false page-summary equality is fully repaired.
